summary: Frontend-only verification of the expanded Connections page (Direct API + Import via export CSV sections) and DSP CSV import flow. All 5 API cards (youtube, soundcloud, tiktok, instagram, twitter) and all 13 export cards (spotify, apple_music, youtube_music, amazon_music, pandora, deezer, tidal, iheartradio, qobuz, bandcamp, beatport, audiomack, boomplay) plus the generic CSV card render with correct branded monogram tiles, colors, and data-testids (platform-card-<key>). Both section headers ('Direct API', 'Import via export (CSV)') are present. Clicking 'Import export' on the Spotify card (data-testid=import-spotify) opened CsvUploadDialog with Platform preselected to 'Spotify'. Uploaded a 5-row CSV (date,streams) via csv-file-input; backend auto-suggested mapping date->date, plays->streams (verified visually). Clicking csv-commit-button produced success toast 'CSV imported — snapshots created.'. After import, the Spotify card badge changed from 'Export-only' to '3.5K tracked' (green). Dashboard 'Reach by platform' now includes a Spotify row (green #1DB954) and a new release 'spotify_test' appeared in Top releases. Refresh sync on the connected YouTube card triggered POST /connections/{id}/sync and returned toast 'Up to date — already synced today.' as expected. No runtime/page errors seen on Connections. Only pre-existing Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) mount warnings (already noted in iteration_1) observed.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer still logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount (cosmetic, unchanged from iteration_1).

action_items: (Cleanup) A test release titled 'spotify_test' (Day-0 2025-01-01, 5 rows) was created on the admin/Luna Eclipse profile during CSV import. Please delete it so admin demo returns to the pristine 3-release state (Take It Easy, Midnight Signal, Neon Rain).
(Optional) TIDAL card uses color #151515 which renders nearly invisible against the dark card background — consider a lighter accent for dark mode readability.
critical_code_review_comments: Connections.js correctly groups platforms by PLATFORMS[k].method via API_PLATFORMS/EXPORT_PLATFORMS derived arrays in common.js — single source of truth.
ExportCard reads reach from analytics/overview platform_breakdown to toggle 'N tracked' vs 'Export-only' badge — good.

CsvUploadDialog accepts defaultPlatform prop and resets to it on close — verified. PLATFORM_OPTS list is hardcoded; if a new platform is added to PLATFORMS but forgotten here, the picker will crash on REGISTRY[k].label. Consider deriving PLATFORM_OPTS from PLATFORMS registry directly.
sync() catches errors but reconnect() has no catch — a failing /reconnect would leave busy state and show no toast.
seed_data_creation: One release 'spotify_test' created via CSV import on Luna Eclipse profile (Spotify platform, Day-0 2025-01-01, ~9K total streams).
